update_message: A new KHOLO experience is ready. Enjoy improved Bloom Health Hub, AI Health Guide, and new features.
releaseNotes:
🌸 KHOLO v1.4.2 (Build 24) — Production Update Release

✨ New Features & Improvements:
• 🌸 KHOLO Bloom Health Hub: Integrated into main bottom navigation for seamless discovery
• 🧠 Upgraded AI Health Guide: Conversational bilingual assistant with evidence-based guidance
• 📚 8 Curated Health Categories: Women's Health, Skin Care, Sexual Wellness, Pregnancy, Baby Care, Men Health, Mental Wellness, Nutrition
• ⚡ Instant Launch (< 50ms startup with resilient background initialization)
• 🛡️ Zero Duplicate Notifications & Smart Dismissal Management
• 🔒 100% On-Device Data Safety (Cycle, Pregnancy, Baby, Profiles & Bookmarks preserved)
